hostel_warden.text: Welcome, pilgrim. The beds are narrow but the stories are wide.
In the Middle Ages the Pope ruled that two pilgrimages to St Davids were worth one to Rome. Three were worth one to Jerusalem. A bargain.
David is Dewi Sant in Welsh, the patron saint of Wales. His day is the first of March, when people wear a leek or a daffodil.

hostel_pilgrim.text: I walked the coast path to get here. My feet say it was the long way. The cathedral says well done.
